_comment: Values marked CALIBRATE are placeholders: they must be measured on the real setup.

vision._comment: Thesis values: diff on grayscale (diff_mode='gray'), aspect 0.8-1.2. Aspect depends on camera tilt (blob = top + front face).

grid._comment: CALIBRATE: robot-frame centre of CELL_0_0 and unit steps along rows/cols (metres).

robot._comment_angles: CALIBRATE: firmware_deg = offset + sign * degrees(q_ik). Order: base, shoulder, elbow, wrist_pitch.
robot._comment_grip: Measured on the real Braccio++: 200 = hand fully open (HOME, approach, release), 150 = grasp. Higher = more open. Do NOT use the firmware limits (120/230): the gripper servo stalls and stops responding.

calibration._comment_marker: Marker centre in the tip frame (z along the gripper, toward the fingers): measured 10 cm back from the grasp point. tip_heights_m: heights of the grasp point above the table for the calibration poses.

planner._comment: backend: fast-downward (pip install up-fast-downward) or ff. command is used only by ff: ["wsl", "./ff"] on Windows (thesis setup), the ff path elsewhere.

llm._comment: OpenRouter (OpenAI-compatible). The key is read from the env var named in api_key_env. For LM Studio: base_url http://localhost:1234/v1, api_key "lm-studio".
